sentences.tc: 有什麼東西你在墨西哥找得到，但在美國找不到？

englishTokens.text: What's something you can find in Mexico but you can't find in the US?

sentences.en: Um, something I can find in Mexico but can't find in the US is probably handmade goods.
sentences.tc: 嗯，我在墨西哥找得到但在美國找不到的東西，大概是手工製品。

englishTokens.text: Um, something I can find in Mexico but can't find in the US is probably handmade goods.

sentences.en: Handmade goods.
sentences.tc: 手工製品。

englishTokens.text: Handmade goods.

sentences.en: So whether that be clothing or utensils at times, um, it's relatively easy to find handmade goods in Mexico.
sentences.tc: 所以不管是衣服，或有時候是器具，嗯，在墨西哥要找到手工製品相對容易。

englishTokens.text: So whether that be clothing or
utensils
at times, um, it's relatively easy to find handmade goods in Mexico.

sentences.en: If you go to a market, you can probably find pots, pans, or clothing.
sentences.tc: 如果你去市場，你大概可以找到鍋子、平底鍋，或衣服。

englishTokens.text: If you go to a market, you can probably find pots, pans, or clothing.

sentences.en: You can find a lot of handmade stuff in Mexico still.
sentences.tc: 在墨西哥還是可以找到很多手工做的東西。

englishTokens.text: You can find a lot of handmade stuff in Mexico still.

sentences.en: And in the US, it's a little harder.
sentences.tc: 在美國就比較難。

englishTokens.text: And in the US, it's a little harder.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: And they're quality products, too.
sentences.tc: 而且它們也是品質好的產品。

englishTokens.text: And they're quality products, too.

sentences.en: They're not cheap.
sentences.tc: 它們不便宜。

englishTokens.text: They're not cheap.

sentences.en: Are there any brands that you wish you had in Mexico?
sentences.tc: 有沒有什麼品牌是你希望墨西哥也有的？

englishTokens.text: Are there any brands that you wish you had in Mexico?

sentences.en: I'd say nothing.
sentences.tc: 我會說沒有。

englishTokens.text: I'd say nothing.

sentences.en: Uh, everything that I like, Mexico already has.
sentences.tc: 呃，我喜歡的東西，墨西哥已經都有了。

englishTokens.text: Uh, everything that I like, Mexico already has.

sentences.en: So, as far as my tastes go, I'm okay.
sentences.tc: 所以，就我的口味來說，我沒問題。

englishTokens.text: So,
as far as
my tastes go, I'm okay.

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.tc: 好。

englishTokens.text: Okay.

sentences.en: For me, it would be Crumbl Cookies.
sentences.tc: 對我來說，會是 Crumbl Cookies。

englishTokens.text: For me, it would be Crumbl Cookies.

sentences.en: I think Crumbl Cookies are too sweet.
sentences.tc: 我覺得 Crumbl Cookies 太甜了。

englishTokens.text: I think Crumbl Cookies are too sweet.

sentences.en: I don't like them.
sentences.tc: 我不喜歡。

englishTokens.text: I don't like them.

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.tc: 好。

englishTokens.text: Okay.

sentences.en: Now, some typical foods in the US versus Mexico.
sentences.tc: 現在聊聊美國和墨西哥的典型食物。

englishTokens.text: Now, some typical foods in the US versus Mexico.

sentences.en: What do you usually eat for breakfast in Mexico versus in the US?
sentences.tc: 你在墨西哥和在美國早餐通常吃什麼？

englishTokens.text: What do you usually eat for breakfast in Mexico versus in the US?

sentences.en: A common breakfast in the US is cereal.
sentences.tc: 美國常見的早餐是麥片。

englishTokens.text: A common breakfast in the US is cereal.

sentences.en: Um, Cheerios, Corn Pops, Froot Loops, and all different kinds of cereal.
sentences.tc: 嗯，Cheerios、Corn Pops、Froot Loops，還有各種不同的麥片。

englishTokens.text: Um, Cheerios, Corn Pops, Froot Loops, and all different kinds of cereal.

sentences.en: Uh, so just cereal and milk, and that's your breakfast.
sentences.tc: 呃，就是麥片加牛奶，這就是你的早餐。

englishTokens.text: Uh, so just cereal and milk, and that's your breakfast.

sentences.en: And in Mexico, I'd say a common breakfast is usually something a little more salty or spicy.
sentences.tc: 而在墨西哥，我會說常見的早餐通常是比較鹹或比較辣的東西。

englishTokens.text: And in Mexico, I'd say a common breakfast is usually something a little more salty or spicy.

sentences.en: We have chilaquiles and enchiladas.
sentences.tc: 我們有 chilaquiles 和 enchiladas。

englishTokens.text: We have chilaquiles and enchiladas.

sentences.en: I think the main difference for me is that in the US, breakfast is sweet, and in Mexico, breakfast is savory.
sentences.tc: 對我來說主要差別是，美國的早餐是甜的，而墨西哥的早餐是鹹香的。

englishTokens.text: I think the main difference for me is that in the US, breakfast is sweet, and in Mexico, breakfast is
savory

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: But from what I remember, when I was a kid in the US, we would always have pancakes and bacon for breakfast.
sentences.tc: 但就我記得，小時候在美國，我們早餐總是吃鬆餅和培根。

englishTokens.text: But from what I remember, when I was a kid in the US, we would always have pancakes and bacon for breakfast.

sentences.en: And in Mexico, my go-to breakfast is always chilaquiles.
sentences.tc: 而在墨西哥，我固定會選的早餐永遠是 chilaquiles。

englishTokens.text: And in Mexico, my
go-to
breakfast is always chilaquiles.

sentences.en: When I go to a coffee shop, or if I get to choose what to have, it's chilaquiles.
sentences.tc: 我去咖啡店，或如果我能選要吃什麼，就是 chilaquiles。

englishTokens.text: When I go to a coffee shop, or if I get to choose what to have, it's chilaquiles.

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.tc: 對，絕對是。

englishTokens.text: Yeah, definitely.

sentences.en: And which do you like more, breakfast in the US or breakfast in Mexico?
sentences.tc: 那你比較喜歡哪個，美國的早餐還是墨西哥的早餐？

englishTokens.text: And which do you like more, breakfast in the US or breakfast in Mexico?

sentences.en: I like breakfast in Mexico because I am a fan of salty foods.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡墨西哥的早餐，因為我是鹹食的愛好者。

englishTokens.text: I like breakfast in Mexico because I am a fan of salty foods.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.tc: 對。

englishTokens.text: Yeah.

sentences.en: I think it has more flavor, too.
sentences.tc: 我覺得它味道也比較豐富。

englishTokens.text: I think it has more flavor, too.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: And what's a typical lunch or dinner in Mexico?
sentences.tc: 墨西哥典型的午餐或晚餐是什麼？

englishTokens.text: And what's a typical lunch or dinner in Mexico?

sentences.en: A typical lunch, um, usually has some kind of tortilla and maybe a type of salsa, soup, or rice.
sentences.tc: 典型午餐，嗯，通常會有某種玉米餅，也可能有某種莎莎醬、湯或飯。

englishTokens.text: A typical lunch, um, usually has some kind of tortilla and maybe a type of salsa, soup, or rice.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: And what about in the US?
sentences.tc: 那美國呢？

englishTokens.text: And what about in the US?

sentences.en: In the US, pasta is a little more common.
sentences.tc: 在美國，義大利麵比較常見。

englishTokens.text: In the US, pasta is a little more common.

sentences.en: You don't usually see rice or beans as much.
sentences.tc: 你通常不會那麼常看到米飯或豆子。

englishTokens.text: You don't usually see rice or beans as much.

sentences.en: And instead of a tortilla, you'll have some bread.
sentences.tc: 而且不是玉米餅，你會有一些麵包。

englishTokens.text: And instead of a tortilla, you'll have some bread.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.tc: 對。

englishTokens.text: Yeah.

sentences.en: And do you think people in Mexico cook more at home or eat out at a restaurant?
sentences.tc: 你覺得墨西哥人比較常在家煮，還是出去餐廳吃？

englishTokens.text: And do you think people in Mexico cook more at home or eat out at a restaurant?

sentences.en: I think in both places, it's common for normal families to eat at home.
sentences.tc: 我覺得兩個地方一般家庭在家吃飯都很常見。

englishTokens.text: I think in both places, it's common for normal families to eat at home.

sentences.en: Uh, most families in the US and in Mexico.
sentences.tc: 呃，美國和墨西哥大多數家庭都是。

englishTokens.text: Uh, most families in the US and in Mexico.

sentences.en: Yes, in the US and in Mexico, because eating out is very expensive in both places.
sentences.tc: 對，在美國和墨西哥都是，因為外食在兩個地方都很貴。

englishTokens.text: Yes, in the US and in Mexico, because eating out is very expensive in both places.

sentences.en: So, most families eat at home.
sentences.tc: 所以，大多數家庭在家吃飯。

englishTokens.text: So, most families eat at home.

sentences.en: But, uh, with the USA's fast food options, sometimes it can be easy for any family to go out.
sentences.tc: 不過，呃，因為美國有速食選擇，有時候任何家庭要出去吃都會很方便。

englishTokens.text: But, uh, with the USA's fast food
options
, sometimes it can be easy for any family to go out.

sentences.en: But in Mexico, not many people like fast food, and fast food isn't as cheap as it is in the US.
sentences.tc: 但在墨西哥，不是很多人喜歡速食，而且速食不像在美國那樣便宜。

englishTokens.text: But in Mexico, not many people like fast food, and fast food isn't as cheap as it is in the US.

sentences.en: I would say that in Mexico, people cook more at home, but in the US, they go out to eat more, just at fast food places.
sentences.tc: 我會說在墨西哥，人們比較常在家煮，但在美國，他們比較常出去吃，只是在速食店。

englishTokens.text: I would say that in Mexico, people cook more at home, but in the US, they go out to eat more, just at fast food places.

sentences.en: So, cheap places, maybe at least three times a week.
sentences.tc: 所以是便宜的地方，也許一週至少三次。

englishTokens.text: So, cheap places, maybe at least three times a week.

sentences.en: Um, and what time is lunch in Mexico?
sentences.tc: 嗯，那墨西哥午餐是幾點？

englishTokens.text: Um, and what time is lunch in Mexico?

sentences.en: Lunch can be around 12:00, 12:00 or 1:00, and dinner is around 4:00 or 5:00.
sentences.tc: 午餐可能在 12 點左右，12 點或 1 點，而晚餐在 4 點或 5 點左右。

englishTokens.text: Lunch can be around 12:00, 12:00 or 1:00, and dinner is around 4:00 or 5:00.

sentences.en: And what about lunch in the US?
sentences.tc: 那美國的午餐呢？

englishTokens.text: And what about lunch in the US?

sentences.en: In the US, I would also say probably about 12:00.
sentences.tc: 在美國，我也會說大概 12 點。

englishTokens.text: In the US, I would also say probably about 12:00.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: And then dinner around 6:00 or 7:00, a little later in the evening.
sentences.tc: 然後晚餐大概 6 點或 7 點，晚上稍微晚一點。

englishTokens.text: And then dinner around 6:00 or 7:00, a little later in the evening.

sentences.en: What I've noticed from different Mexican families is that breakfast is usually small.
sentences.tc: 我從不同墨西哥家庭注意到的是，早餐通常很小。

englishTokens.text: What I've noticed from different Mexican families is that breakfast is usually small.

sentences.en: Like a smoothie or just something for the early morning, like 8:00, and then a little lunch around 12:00.
sentences.tc: 像一杯 smoothie，或只是早上 8 點那種簡單的東西，然後 12 點左右吃一點午餐。

englishTokens.text: Like a smoothie or just something for the early morning, like 8:00, and then a little lunch around 12:00.

sentences.en: And then dinner is like 4:00 or 5:00.
sentences.tc: 接著晚餐大概是 4 點或 5 點。

englishTokens.text: And then dinner is like 4:00 or 5:00.

sentences.en: And then before you go to sleep, you have hot chocolate with sweet bread or coffee with sweet bread.
sentences.tc: 然後睡覺前，你會喝熱巧克力配甜麵包，或咖啡配甜麵包。

englishTokens.text: And then before you go to sleep, you have hot chocolate with sweet bread or coffee with sweet bread.

sentences.en: That's what I've noticed with my friends and with family, that I've seen how they have their schedule.
sentences.tc: 這是我從朋友和家人那裡注意到的，我看過他們的作息。

englishTokens.text: That's what I've noticed with my friends and with family, that I've seen how they have their schedule.

sentences.en: And even in our family, we have an early breakfast, a little lunch at like 1:00, and then dinner at 5:00.
sentences.tc: 甚至在我們家，我們會早點吃早餐，1 點左右吃一點午餐，然後 5 點吃晚餐。

englishTokens.text: And even in our family, we have an early breakfast, a little lunch at like 1:00, and then dinner at 5:00.

sentences.en: And then a snack like Cheetos at night.
sentences.tc: 晚上再吃像 Cheetos 這樣的點心。

englishTokens.text: And then a snack like Cheetos at night.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: So, do you feel like food is more social in Mexico or in the US?
sentences.tc: 所以，你覺得食物在墨西哥還是在美國更社交？

englishTokens.text: So, do you feel like food is more social in Mexico or in the US?

sentences.en: Everyday meals are more social in Mexico.
sentences.tc: 日常用餐在墨西哥更社交。

englishTokens.text: Everyday meals are more social in Mexico.

sentences.en: Lots of Mexican families always eat their dinner together, their lunch together.
sentences.tc: 很多墨西哥家庭總是一起吃晚餐，一起吃午餐。

englishTokens.text: Lots of Mexican families always eat their dinner together, their lunch together.

sentences.en: Whatever meals they can eat together, they will eat together.
sentences.tc: 只要是能一起吃的餐，他們就會一起吃。

englishTokens.text: Whatever meals they can eat together, they will eat together.

sentences.en: And, um, in the US, sometimes it's not prioritized to eat together.
sentences.tc: 而，嗯，在美國，有時候一起吃飯不會被優先重視。

englishTokens.text: And, um, in the US, sometimes it's not
prioritized
to eat together.

sentences.en: I agree.
sentences.tc: 我同意。

englishTokens.text: I agree.

sentences.en: I think meals are more social in Mexico.
sentences.tc: 我覺得在墨西哥，吃飯更社交。

englishTokens.text: I think meals are more social in Mexico.

sentences.en: I think it's part of the culture.
sentences.tc: 我覺得那是文化的一部分。

englishTokens.text: I think it's part of the culture.

sentences.en: We're just more family-oriented.
sentences.tc: 我們就是更以家庭為中心。

englishTokens.text: We're just more
family-oriented

sentences.en: Which food culture do you prefer, American or Mexican?
sentences.tc: 你比較喜歡哪種飲食文化，美國還是墨西哥？

englishTokens.text: Which food culture do you prefer, American or Mexican?

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.tc: 為什麼？

englishTokens.text: And why?

sentences.en: I prefer the food culture that Mexico has.
sentences.tc: 我比較喜歡墨西哥的飲食文化。

englishTokens.text: I prefer the food culture that Mexico has.

sentences.en: I think it is very similar to the life I had when I grew up.
sentences.tc: 我覺得它很像我成長時的生活。

englishTokens.text: I think it is very similar to the life I had when I
grew up

sentences.en: My family has always eaten together and used food to bring the family together.
sentences.tc: 我的家人一直都一起吃飯，也用食物把家人聚在一起。

englishTokens.text: My family has always eaten together and used food to
bring the family together

sentences.en: So, I really enjoy that.
sentences.tc: 所以我真的很喜歡那樣。

englishTokens.text: So, I really enjoy that.

sentences.en: I also prefer Mexican food because I enjoy spicy flavors and salty flavors a little more.
sentences.tc: 我也比較喜歡墨西哥食物，因為我更喜歡辣味和鹹味。

englishTokens.text: I also prefer Mexican food because I enjoy spicy flavors and salty flavors a little more.

sentences.en: Yeah, I enjoy both.
sentences.tc: 對，我兩種都喜歡。

englishTokens.text: Yeah, I enjoy both.

sentences.en: I've never really liked spicy food.
sentences.tc: 我其實從來不是很喜歡辣的食物。

englishTokens.text: I've never really liked spicy food.

sentences.en: I like the flavors in Mexico, but I think that the flavors in the US are also very good.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡墨西哥的味道，但我覺得美國的味道也很好。

englishTokens.text: I like the flavors in Mexico, but I think that the flavors in the US are also very good.

sentences.en: I just think it's a little bit too much for me.
sentences.tc: 我只是覺得對我來說有點太多了。

englishTokens.text: I just think it's a little bit too much for me.

sentences.en: And in Mexico, I feel like there might be more of a balance between the spices, the vegetables, and the flavor.
sentences.tc: 而在墨西哥，我覺得香料、蔬菜和味道之間可能更有平衡。

sentences.tc: 我同意。

englishTokens.text: I agree.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.en: So, what's your favorite comfort food in each country?
sentences.tc: 所以，你在每個國家最喜歡的療癒食物是什麼？

englishTokens.text: So, what's your favorite
comfort food
in each country?

sentences.en: My favorite comfort food in the US is probably Flamin' Hot Cheetos because I have a lot of memories with Flamin' Hot Cheetos as a kid.
sentences.tc: 我在美國最喜歡的療癒食物大概是 Flamin' Hot Cheetos，因為我小時候有很多和 Flamin' Hot Cheetos 有關的回憶。

englishTokens.text: My favorite comfort food in the US is probably Flamin' Hot Cheetos because I have a lot of memories with Flamin' Hot Cheetos as a kid.

sentences.en: And they have a more, um, limey flavor in the USA that they don't have in Mexico.
sentences.tc: 而且美國的它們有更酸檸檬的味道，墨西哥的沒有那種味道。

englishTokens.text: And they have a more, um, limey flavor in the USA that they don't have in Mexico.

sentences.en: Mhm.
sentences.tc: 嗯。

englishTokens.text: Mhm.

sentences.tc: 對。

englishTokens.text: Then in Mexico, I would say my comfort food is probably chalupas.

sentences.tc: 我真的很喜歡 chalupas：馬鈴薯、生菜、一點莎莎醬，有時候還有一點雞肉。

englishTokens.text: I really like chalupas: the potatoes, the lettuce, and a little bit of salsa, and sometimes a little bit of chicken.

sentences.en: I think it's really good and refreshing, and everything I like.
sentences.tc: 我覺得它真的很好吃又清爽，而且都是我喜歡的東西。

englishTokens.text: I think it's really good and
refreshing
, and everything I like.

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.tc: 嗯哼。

englishTokens.text: Uh-huh.

sentences.en: I didn't know that.
sentences.tc: 我不知道耶。

englishTokens.text: I didn't know that.

sentences.en: Um, in Mexico, I'm sure you know, chilaquiles suizos are my comfort food.
sentences.tc: 嗯，在墨西哥，我相信你知道，chilaquiles suizos 是我的療癒食物。

englishTokens.text: Um, in Mexico, I'm sure you know, chilaquiles suizos are my comfort food.

sentences.tc: 它們就是滿滿的起司和酸奶油。

englishTokens.text: They're just full of cheese and sour cream.

sentences.en: And they're just the perfect comfort food for when you're not looking to be healthy or to feel light.

light

englishTokens.text: You're looking for comfort.

sentences.tc: 那就是我在墨西哥的療癒食物。

englishTokens.text: And that's my comfort food in Mexico.

sentences.en: But in the US, probably, yeah, I think Flamin' Hot Cheetos because of the memories.

breakdowns.sentence: Today I will be having a conversation with my sister about the differences between Mexico and the USA.
breakdowns.translation: 今天我會和我妹妹聊聊墨西哥和美國之間的差異。

points.label: 未來進行式
points.note: 用來表示未來某個時間會正在進行的動作，這裡強調今天節目中會進行一場對話。

breakdowns.sentence: We have both lived in the United States and in Mexico.
breakdowns.translation: 我們兩個都在美國和墨西哥住過。

points.label: 現在完成式
points.note: 表示過去的經驗和現在有關，這裡說兩人都有住過兩個國家的經驗。

breakdowns.sentence: You are meant to buy groceries for a whole week or the whole month.
breakdowns.translation: 你本來就是要買一整週或一整個月的雜貨。

points.label: 被動語態慣用句 be meant to
points.note: 表示某件事被設計或預期要這樣做，這裡指美國大賣場的購物方式是預期一次買很多。

breakdowns.sentence: Organic food is more expensive, but I feel like access to fresh food or farmers' markets is better in Mexico than in the US.
breakdowns.translation: 有機食品比較貴，但我覺得在墨西哥取得新鮮食物或農夫市集的機會比美國好。

points.label: 比較級
points.note: 用 more expensive 和 better than 比較兩個地方或兩種情況。

breakdowns.sentence: I would say it's more common to go to little stores.

points.label: would say 表示委婉看法
points.note: 用 would say 讓語氣比較委婉，表示這是說話者的看法，而不是絕對事實。

breakdowns.sentence: So whether that be clothing or utensils at times, it's relatively easy to find handmade goods in Mexico.
breakdowns.translation: 所以不管是衣服，或有時候是器具，在墨西哥要找到手工製品相對容易。

points.label: whether that be 讓步／列舉句型
points.note: 用來列舉可能的情況，意思接近不管是……，語氣比 whether it is 更正式或口語固定化。

breakdowns.sentence: What I miss most is the chips.

points.label: 名詞子句當主詞
points.note: What I miss most 整段當作主詞，表示我最想念的東西。

breakdowns.sentence: There are so many sweets in the United States that you can try.
breakdowns.translation: 美國有好多你可以試的甜食。

points.label: so...that 結果句型
points.note: 表示程度高到造成某種結果，這裡是甜食多到可以試很多種。

breakdowns.sentence: I used to miss the food in the United States when we first came to Mexico.
breakdowns.translation: 我們剛來墨西哥時，我以前會想念美國的食物。

points.label: used to 表過去習慣
points.note: 表示以前常常或曾經如此，但現在不一定如此。

breakdowns.sentence: Their palate is not used to such a strong flavor.
breakdowns.translation: 他們的味覺還不習慣那麼強烈的味道。

points.label: be used to + noun
points.note: 表示習慣某事物，後面接名詞或動名詞，不是接原形動詞。

breakdowns.sentence: Now that I have been in Mexico for 10 years, I do like mole.
breakdowns.translation: 現在我在墨西哥已經 10 年了，我是喜歡 mole 的。

points.label: now that 原因句
points.note: now that 表示既然現在情況已經如此，用來說明後面結果的原因。

breakdowns.sentence: I have been in the US for 12 years and in Mexico for another 12.
breakdowns.translation: 我在美國住了 12 年，在墨西哥也住了另外 12 年。

points.label: 現在完成式加 for
points.note: 用 for 加一段時間，表示某狀態持續了多久。

breakdowns.sentence: It's been a long time since I've had a physical home in the USA.
breakdowns.translation: 我已經很久沒有在美國有一個實體的家了。

points.label: It has been + time + since
points.text: It has been + time expression + since + clause
points.note: 表示自從某件事之後已經過了多久。

breakdowns.sentence: If I were to leave, I would also miss my family.
breakdowns.translation: 如果我要離開，我也會想念我的家人。

points.label: 假設語氣
points.text: If + subject + were to + verb, subject + would + verb
points.note: 用 were to 表示假設情況，不是真的已經發生。

breakdowns.sentence: It's not as cheap as it is in the US.
breakdowns.translation: 它不像在美國那樣便宜。

points.label: not as...as 比較句型
points.note: 表示沒有另一者那麼……，這裡說墨西哥速食不像美國那麼便宜。

breakdowns.sentence: Whereas on the metro bus, almost nothing ever happens beyond pickpocketing.
breakdowns.translation: 而在 metro bus 上，除了扒竊以外幾乎什麼事都不會發生。

points.label: whereas 對比連接詞
points.note: whereas 用來連接或引出對比情況，常翻成然而、相較之下。
